sources.title: Mid-Long Term Daily Electricity Consumption Forecasting Based on Piecewise Linear Regression and Dilated Causal CNN
sources.snippet: Daily electricity consumption forecasting is a classical problem. Existing forecasting algorithms tend to have decreased accuracy on special dates like holidays. This study decomposes the daily electricity consumption series into three components: trend, seasonal, and residual, and constructs a two-stage prediction method using piecewise linear regression as a filter and Dilated Causal CNN as a predictor. sources.title: Optimizing Allreduce Operations for Modern Heterogeneous Architectures with Multiple Processes per GPU
sources.snippet: Large inter-GPU all-reduce operations, prevalent throughout deep learning, are bottlenecked by communication costs. Emerging heterogeneous architectures are comprised of complex nodes, often containing $4$ GPUs and dozens to hundreds of CPU cores per node. Parallel applications are typically accelerated on the available GPUs, using only a single CPU core per GPU while the remaining cores sit idle.
